description_en: Designed for efficiently detecting and recognizing printed English characters in fully English image-based documents, this solution provides English-specific recognition and English tokenization features, and supports basic functionalities such as rotation handling, table detection, and text coordinate extraction
description_zh: 针对全英文图片文档场景下英文印刷体字符高效检测和识别，具备英文专项识别和英文分词功能，支持旋转、表格、文字坐标等多项基础功能
kebab_example: aliyun ocr-api recognize-english --url https://help-static-aliyun-doc.aliyuncs.com/file-manage-files/zh-CN/20241218/lvwnly/%E8%8B%B1%E8%AF%AD%E4%BD%9C%E6%96%87%E8%AF%86%E5%88%AB.png --biz-body '图片二进制文件' --need-rotate false --output-table false --region cn-hangzhou
name: RecognizeEnglish

parameters.help_en:
This field and the body field are mutually exclusive—you must specify one and only one of them.  
Image URL (must not exceed 2 048 bytes in length; base64 is not supported)
parameters.help_zh:
本字段和body字段二选一，不可同时透传或同时为空。
图片链接（长度不超2048字节，不支持base64）
parameters.name: url

parameters.help_en:
This field and the URL field are mutually exclusive—you must specify one and only one of them.  
Binary file of the image, up to 10 MB in size.  
When invoking via HTTP, upload the binary image file in the HTTP body.  
When using the software development kit (SDK), place the image in the SDK body
parameters.help_zh:
本字段和URL字段二选一，不可同时透传或同时为空。
图片二进制文件，最大10MB。
使用HTTP方式调用，把图片二进制文件放到HTTP body中上传即可。
使用SDK的方式调用，把图片放到SDK的body中即可
parameters.name: body

parameters.help_en:
Specifies whether automatic rotation is required. By default, it is not required.  
true: required; false: not required
parameters.help_zh:
是否需要自动旋转功能，默认不需要。
true：需要；false：不需要
parameters.name: need_rotate

parameters.help_en:
Specifies whether to output the table recognition result, including cell information. By default, it is not required.  
true: required; false: not required
parameters.help_zh:
是否输出表格识别结果，包含单元格信息，默认不需要。
true：需要；false：不需要
parameters.name: output_table
